name: url
label: URL
help: Enter a path starting with exactly one /, such as /v1/models. Only endpoints under https://api.acedata.cloud are supported; do not enter a full URL.

name: headers
label: Headers
help: Optional request headers. The AceDataCloud Authorization header is added by the connection; do not enter a token here.

name: body
label: Body
help: Optional raw request body. POST and other writes may incur AceDataCloud charges.
